t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in pairs with various coloured hats and the selection you make will lead you to a bright forest or a dark forest with a different coloured basket - these are the main signals to use when making a decision that can have an effect on how many mushrooms you collect and therefore the bonus you receive

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes will appear in pairs in various colours, orange & Brown, green and pink, red and yellow, blue and purple and may appear in different sides. Nothing else matters regarding the selection. The colour choice you make will lead to a dark or light forest and a different coloured handbasket. These are the only variables that affect the amount of mushrooms
